answer: Here is one concrete wall: Model aircraft club membership with aviation authority registration. It works because a club membership plus authority registration, and the spiral it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the walnut is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Time is the tax here: a club membership plus authority registration cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the kernel for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
